text:
lauren: Heads-up: opening a small PR to fix the Optimize toolkit docs — batching examples + quant profile table has stale flags. Need eyeballs before lunch. PR: #4823. Quick review appreciated :pray:

sam: Thanks. Can you call out which snippets changed? dont want to break SDK users.

lauren: Main changes:
1) batching section shows old batch_size param; should be 'max_batch' in SDK v0.8
2) cache config example missing 'prefix_cache' note
3) quant profiles table removed 'int8-legacy' row
I'll paste diff.

lauren: ```diff
- client.optimize.batch(size=32)
+ client.optimize.batch(max_batch=32)
```

anya: Also update migration guide: users on v0.7 need to change calls, and add a note about fallback behavior when a quantized model sits on a different variant. I can add a paragraph.

miguel: Link fix: the profiling CSV link in "profiling results" points to old S3 path. Should be https://storage.redwood.ai/optimize/profiles/2026-02/profiles.csv

lauren: added the link in PR, but CI docsite build failing on md linting — line length in quant.md. Sam can you run local build?

sam: On it. Quick tip: run ./scripts/doc_build.sh --watch to catch linter. I fixed the line break in my branch and pushed a small format commit.

docs-bot: Documentation CI — build passed: staging preview deployed at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/optimize/updates-1765

anya: QA request: can we add a minimal end-to-end snippet using the SDK for batching + caching? I propose:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# minimal batching + caching example
resp = client.optimize.generate(prompt='Translate to FR: hello', max_batch=8, enable_cache=True)
print(resp.text)
```

Will that be accurate?

lauren: Looks good, tweak: prefer explicit cache param for clarity in the docs. For SDK v0.8 we use enable_cache=True (not a dict). I'll update the snippet to match other examples.

miguel: One more: quant profiles table needs a footnote about expected latency delta for int8 (~+12% at seq=128). Add small note under the table.

sam: :thumbsup: I'm fine to merge once the lint and the E2E snippet are in. Anything blocking release notes?

lauren: I'll draft a short changelog line. Merge target: before next deploy window 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC. Tagging @anya @miguel for follow-ups.

anya: I'll add migration paragraph and run smoke test against dedicated cluster. Will report back in this thread.

docs-bot: PR #4823 merged by lauren — changelog updated. Release note draft: 'Optimize toolkit: batching and caching API updates; quant profiles refreshed; improved migration guide.'
